texts.li: [their:grateful] {X_nameDef} let {A_nameDef} talk the price down further than {X_pronoun} had to. "{FACTION} owe this place," {X_pronoun} said. "Call it a little of that back."
[their:rescued] {A_nameDef} haggled hard, and {X_nameDef} gave way with a smile: {X_pronoun} had heard what the colony did for {FACTION}, and wasn't going to argue over a few silver.
[their:grudge] {X_nameDef} wouldn't come down a single silver for {A_nameDef}, and made sure {A_nameDef} knew why: {FACTION} remember what this colony did.
[their:rescued] {X_nameDef} pressed a twist of something sweet into {A_nameDef}'s hand and wouldn't take anything for it. "{FACTION} haven't forgotten," was all {X_pronoun} said.
[their:grateful] {X_nameDef} opened the good jar for {A_nameDef}, the one {X_pronoun} keeps back for friends of {FACTION}.
[their:grateful] According to {X_nameDef}, they still talk in {FACTION} towns about what this colony did for them. {A_nameDef} pretended not to be pleased.
[their:grudge] {X_nameDef} let it slip to {A_nameDef} that this colony's name isn't a good one among {FACTION}, and that {X_pronoun} only came because the road runs past it.
[their:rescued] Before any news, {X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} to pass on the thanks of a family among {FACTION} who would not be alive without this colony.
[their:owed] Among the news from the road, {X_nameDef} mentioned that {FACTION} had a hard winter, and that they remember who they helped when times were better.
[their:grudge] {X_nameDef}, one of the {FACTION} guards, watched {A_nameDef} the whole visit and didn't trouble to hide it. Some things haven't been forgiven.
